title: Juicy Tender German Tomato Quiche
description: A spicy, tender, kid-friendly German dish featuring grape tomatoes, perfect for a dairy-free-friendly meal. Serve warm and enjoy!

ingredients.name: 1 cup vegan milk
ingredients.notes: almond, soy, or any other brand

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
In a large bowl, whisk together the vegan milk and cornstarch until well combined.
Add the halved grape tomatoes and stir to coat with the milk mixture.
Pour the mixture into 6-8 ramekins or mini cast-iron skillets.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the quiche is set and the crust is golden brown.
If desired, add a sprinkle of paprika and chopped fresh parsley on top of each quiche before serving.
